decls.name: ConjIsComplexConjugationUnderEmbedding

paper_span.quote: Since $L$ is totally real, $c$ becomes ordinary

decls.rationale: Proves the paper's key CM fact: because `L` is totally real, the automorphism `c` becomes ordinary complex conjugation under every complex embedding of `K` — what turns \(u\,c(u)=1\) into \(|\sigma(u)| = 1\).
